content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DRDO DIHAR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Defence Institute of High Altitude Research (DRDO DIHAR), located in Leh, Ladakh.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in DRDO DIHAR recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Junior Research Fellows (JRF) and Research Associate (RA) under project-based openings.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies available, comprising 15 posts for Junior Research Fellows and 2 posts for Research Associates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of selection for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening and verification of testimonials followed by a face-to-face interview during the walk-in.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 14 October 2026. Eligible candidates must report by 0845 hours at the venue.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Junior Research Fellows (JRF)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow post will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Research Associate (RA)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Associate post will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 67,000/- plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for JRF and RA posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years for Junior Research Fellows and 35 years for Research Associates, with relaxation as per GoI orders.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should be brought to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates with Date of Birth and essential qualifications, self-attested copies, neatly typed bio-data, Aadhar card, and supporting experience documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at the Defence Institute of High-Altitude Research (DIHAR), Leh, Union Territory of Ladakh.
